instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Free the places whose hold time has run out, and offer each to the waitlist", and give it ledger_id.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:expire-old-holds and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Ends every confirmed hold whose expiry has passed by this run's clock and, by default, promotes one waiting entry into each freed place.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: capacity-ledger (records:read, records:write).
